subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders if he should just run.
source_quote: For a moment, the priest of Bahamut wonders if he should just run.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers the teachings of Bahamut that when you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.
source_quote: And then he remembers the teachings of Bahamut that when you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes that fighting the giant may gain them friends.
source_quote: “If I fight him, we may get some friends.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir focuses his mind to strike the giant again.
source_quote: So Zalthir uses his power to focus his mind and strikes again.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir strikes the giant once, focusing his mind on striking again.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the giant once, focusing his mind on striking again and striking the air.
